evidence.title: Get Better Code from AI Agents — TStack

name: Stop Vibe Coding
summary: Free PDF guide on getting better code from AI agents: clearer context, sharper tasks and reviewable output.
description: A TStack guide for agent-ready software. It describes the workflow shift from AI as chaotic autocomplete to a delegated engineering partner, and is delivered as a PDF by email: the page has an email field and the note that the guide will be sent to your inbox.
contains: PDF sent by email after entering an address
covers context, tasks and reviewable agent output
